stories.title: Yard Work Reveals Largest Trove of Viking Silver Ever Discovered in Denmark
stories.label: science
stories.summary: A man in Denmark was just digging a new terrace in his backyard when his shovel hit something unexpected. What he found turned out to be the largest hoard of Viking-era silver ever unearthed in the country. Archaeologists are thrilled, since discoveries like this help fill in gaps about how people lived over a thousand years ago. It's a wonderful reminder that history is still hiding right under our feet, waiting to be found.
stories.why_good: A real, already-happened discovery that enriches shared human history and brings joy without any suffering or controversy attached.

stories.title: Arthritis Drug Demonstrates Substantial Hair Regrowth in 1,400 Alopecia Patients
stories.label: health
stories.summary: Doctors found that an existing arthritis medication helped people with severe alopecia regrow their hair, in some cases getting all of it back. The condition affects about 2% of people worldwide and happens when the immune system mistakenly attacks hair follicles. In this real-world trial of 1,400 patients, many saw substantial regrowth after taking the drug. Because it's already an approved medicine, this could mean a real treatment option much sooner for people who've struggled with hair loss for years. It's a rare case where a repurposed drug delivers a big win for a condition with few good treatments.
stories.why_good: A completed trial in 1,400 real patients showing actual hair regrowth from an existing drug is a concrete medical win, not a forecast.

stories.title: A ‘Living Roof’ is Growing Atop Ford’s Largest Factory–Saving Energy and Boosting Birds
stories.label: earth
stories.summary: Ford's massive River Rouge factory in Michigan now has a giant green roof covering acres of the building. The plants growing up there help insulate the factory, cutting down on energy use for heating and cooling. They also soak up rainwater and give birds and pollinators a place to land in an otherwise industrial area. It's a neat full-circle moment too, since Henry Ford once considered turning that same land into a bird sanctuary over a century ago. Big factories don't often double as wildlife habitat, but this one now does.
stories.why_good: A real, already-built green roof on a major factory that cuts energy use and creates habitat for birds and pollinators.
